scope: Read-only static review of resource-bar observer, not native or visual acceptance

finding.title: Visibility and shared-row proof is missing
finding.detail: Track width and numeric textContent remain readable by the observer when a resource is opacity:0, visibility:hidden, off screen, or clipped. The observer stores trackBox but does not inspect it and does not capture row/value boxes or ancestor visibility. This can pass binding correlation while the promised visible meter/number is absent.

verified: Changes from preserved V17 harness are bounded to observer functions and start/finish calls around the existing ordinary-W run.
No gameplay, HUD, resource, or settings writes: the only new page write is a private trace object.
Numeric value uses rounded updateMeter amount; tolerance 1 is conservative for rounding.
clientWidth excludes current one-pixel track border and matches the fill percentage containing block; no track padding exists in current CSS.
Telemetry width is immediate under V18 override; boost retains existing 80ms width interpolation and recent-bound-range allowance.
Natural heat zero/partial/full requirement would reject the prior constant-100-percent fill override.
Native capture, reduced-motion, lifecycle and 60-part flows are unchanged.
limits: Observer sampling is intentionally not frame-rate evidence.
No browser or build executed by reviewer.
